orchestrator.name: orchestrator
orchestrator.description: Lead orchestrator — classifies tasks, plans execution, delegates to subproject agents, and reviews results.

frontend-agent.name: frontend-agent
frontend-agent.description: Frontend specialist — Next.js App Router, React, Tailwind, Shadcn UI, HeroUI, and user-facing features.

backend-agent.name: backend-agent
backend-agent.description: Backend specialist — Supabase, PostgreSQL, API routes, RLS policies, Edge Functions, and data layer.

cost-tracker.name: cost-tracker
cost-tracker.description: Utility agent — analyzes AI usage costs and generates budget reports for GitHub Copilot premium requests.

design-agent.name: design-agent
design-agent.description: UI/UX design specialist — page architecture, component hierarchy, visual structure, and layout decisions for DevCache.

icons-agent.name: icons-agent
icons-agent.description: Icon specialist — selects contextually precise, non-AI-looking icons and enforces visual consistency across the entire DevCache application.

copywriter-agent.name: copywriter-agent
copywriter-agent.description: Copywriting and marketing specialist — crafts all text in DevCache to be purposeful, clear, and context-appropriate.

colors-agent.name: colors-agent
colors-agent.description: Color system specialist — maintains DevCache's color palette, ensures WCAG-compliant contrast, and aligns color choices with emotional intent.
